name: cc-my-pi
description: cc-my-pi — Claude Code-style UI for Pi: grouped tool rows, Shiki diffs, spinner, themes, esc/queue steering, and a /cc-my-pi settings panel. Personal fork of FammasMaz/pi-cc-tools.
author: Tim van den Hoorn
